facts.fact: On 2026-07-30 ATC Uganda paid UGX 20.9 billion to the Uganda Communications Commission as its statutory 2% of gross annual revenue; the levy finances UCUSAF, set up under section 3(g) of the Uganda Communications Act, 2013, and half of the 2% goes to the Consolidated Fund while the balance is retained by UCC for UCUSAF, per the UCC Executive Director.
facts.system: UCUSAF (Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund)

systems.country_label: Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund

note: The fund has put ICT laboratories in more than 1,000 public secondary schools, without a date.
